name: independent-c33
articleHashesNote: Article hashes were captured from the working tree at run start, before the first step of this record; they are the bytes committed on this branch.

steps.action: create-knowledge "Before you start": Knowledge opens with the authoring controls for this role
steps.actual: Knowledge opened with the New action, the All Knowledge folder entry and the Knowledge items list

steps.action: create-knowledge "Start with files" steps 1-3: two files become two filename-titled drafts in Library
steps.actual: Create drafts answered 201 with two items titled Rev C33 administrator 95B8E2 policy A.pdf and Rev C33 administrator 95B8E2 policy B.pdf; each was Draft, Legal Only, filed in Library with its own primary Document, the first opened at its record and the second was listed in Knowledge

steps.action: create-knowledge "Start with files" step 4: Title saves on Enter and Type saves on change, both surviving reload
steps.actual: Enter saved the title and the heading followed it; the Type selection saved to Precedent on change and both values were still there after a reload

steps.action: create-knowledge "Start with guidance" steps 1-4: a guidance-only item with rendered Markdown
steps.actual: Create item made a Draft Legal Only Article with Primary document None; Add guidance took Markdown, Preview rendered its heading and link and saved on the editor blur, and the source was still there after a reload

steps.action: create-knowledge "Add Documents and choose the primary" steps 1-3
steps.actual: Upload added plain.docx as a second Document; Set as primary marked its row Primary and named it in the Primary document control, Open preview opened and closed its current Version, and the original file stayed on the item as a supporting Document with its own single-version chain

steps.action: create-knowledge "Add Documents" note: an item’s Documents are a flat list with no folder control
steps.actual: The record’s Documents section offered no folder button or folder filter, so its Documents read as one flat list

steps.action: create-knowledge "Organize the library" steps 2-4: nested folders, cycle-safe parent choices and sibling order
steps.actual: Add folder with All Knowledge selected made a top-level folder and with that folder selected made a child under it; the move dialog offered neither the folder itself nor its descendant as a parent; Save folder renamed it and the up/down controls moved it one sibling position and back (displayOrder 11→10→11, taking 1 and 1 click(s))

steps.action: create-knowledge "Organize the library" step 4: an item moves by changing its record Folder
steps.actual: The record’s Folder control moved the item into Rev C33 administrator 95B8E2 child; the child folder listed it and the parent folder listed it too, so a folder selection reads its descendants

steps.action: create-knowledge "Organize the library" step 1: Type narrows the list on its own and Clear filters restores it
steps.actual: Type, State, Audience, Author and Format were each offered; Type=Article kept the guidance item and dropped the Precedent, State=Published then hid the draft as well, and clearing both filters brought the item back

steps.action: create-knowledge "Organize the library" step 5: dissolving a folder promotes its children and keeps every item
steps.actual: The delete dialog said its folders and items move to the parent and that nothing is deleted; after Delete folder the child folder became top-level, the item stayed in that child folder and still held both of its Documents

steps.action: create-knowledge "Recover from an unavailable choice" negative: an archived Knowledge type is not offered
steps.actual: The separately prepared archived Knowledge type "Rev C33 archived type 95C160" was absent from the record Type control and from the New Knowledge Item dialog, while the live Playbook type was still offered

steps.action: create-knowledge "Recover from an unavailable choice" negative: an archived item takes no edit and no upload
steps.actual: Archiving the guidance item marked it Archived and disabled Title, Type, Folder and Audience while the Upload control disappeared; a direct upload to the archived item answered 409; the saved record address still opened after a reload and Restore returned it to an editable state

steps.action: create-knowledge "Recover from an unavailable choice": Manage types… is offered to Administrators only
steps.actual: Manage types… was beside Type and opened Settings / Knowledge types
